title: Scope.
officialText:
Duct systems used for the movement of air in air-conditioning, heating, ventilating and exhaust systems shall conform
to the provisions of this chapter except as otherwise specified in Chapters 5 and 7.
Exception: Ducts discharging combustible material directly into any combustion chamber shall conform to the requirements of
NFPA 82.
